name: iap-promo
description: Generate App Store-compliant promoted In-App Purchase images (1024x1024, original art — not screenshots). Avoids Apple Guideline 2.3.2 rejections.

scripts.example: node bin/iap-promo.mjs --title "My App Premium" --badge PREMIUM --subtitle "Unlock everything" --benefits "No ads|Offline mode|Pro themes" --price "$2.99/mo" --theme ocean --out example.png
